SPEC_TEXT: SystemState is the canonical union INIT|READY|RUNNING|VERIFYING|CONSENSUS|STABLE|FREEZE|STOP; GET /api/runs/:id returns data.state: SystemState.
EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: GET /api/runs/:id never emits a successful canonical response whose data.state is outside SystemState.
Persistence/provider values are validated before serialization to the canonical API contract.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Pass an arbitrary persisted string through as data.state while claiming the SystemState wire type.
Invent a new transition or state value to accommodate malformed persistence.
